title: Arcane Librarian of Stasis
description: A hooded female mage in purple and green robes stands inside a gothic library, holding an open red book and a glowing orb-topped staff. In the foreground, a large glass hourglass with red sand and a golden butterfly emblem hangs above an illuminated purple book titled STASIS, all resting on a wooden desk with scattered papers, a quill, and ink.
prompt: A mystical female mage wearing purple hooded robes with green patterns stands in an ornate gothic library filled with bookshelves and glowing potions. She holds an open red spellbook in one hand and a golden staff with a glowing orb in the other. In the foreground, a large magical glass hourglass filled with red sand and a golden butterfly symbol drips green liquid, chained above an open purple book titled STASIS with golden wing emblem. Desk has parchment, quill and ink. Dramatic blue and purple lighting, cinematic fantasy style.
